rationale: Price remains below the $170.90 invalidation and is oscillating tightly around the 9-EMA ($170.48), which has acted as resistance since entry; the last candle did probe down to $170.16 before bouncing, suggesting sellers are still present near this level. The primary concern is SPY up ~1% today creating a market-wide headwind for shorts, and the very low inter-candle volume (mostly 200–1,000 shares) indicates price discovery is limited and the move has stalled rather than accelerated. With 85 minutes remaining and the position still technically within parameters, the short is worth holding for one more candle sequence to see if sellers reassert, but proximity to both entry and the 9-EMA warrants close monitoring against invalidation.
